'''Tyrral Jerikko''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] citizen of the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]] living during the [[war against Zakuul]]. By the time Empress [[Vaylin]] took the [[Eternal Throne]], he was a Battalion Commander in the ranks of the [[Knights of Zakuul]]. In [[3630 BBY]], Jerikko was part of the [[Assault on Odessen]] initiated by the Empress against the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]]. He was part of the force that attempted to seize the ''[[Gravestone]]'' while the vessel was in dry dock, however during the battle he was attacked by [[Lana Beniko]] and [[Alliance Commander|the Alliance Commander]] and was killed.

==Behind the scenes==
Tyrral Jerikko appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' during '''"Chapter VIII: End Times".'''
